jobs.title: Sr Director, Operations Finance
jobs.description:
**Department:** Finance
  
**Reports to:** Vice President, Business Finance
  
**Status:** Full\-time
  
**Location:** Hybrid/Head office (10 Carlson Court, Etobicoke)
  
Purpose
  
Gay Lea is modernizing its finance function to better support enterprise decision\-making, performance, and growth. This includes reducing manual reporting, strengthening planning processes, and leveraging improved tools and data capabilities.
  
This role is accountable for the financial performance of the manufacturing network, partnering with Operations to improve profitability through better manufacturing performance, asset utilization, and cost management.
  
The role owns costing methodology and manufacturing cost standards across the network and leads the plant controller community in delivering consistent financial visibility and performance management across all sites.
  
As a senior business partner to Operations leadership, the role converts plant and network data into operational decisions, surfaces cost and capacity trade\-offs, and shifts site finance effort from reporting to decision support.
  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**  

* Partner with Operations to improve profitability through manufacturing performance, asset utilization, and cost management
* Support manufacturing decisions through financial analysis of costs, productivity, capacity, and investments
* Develop consistent costing methodologies, BOM governance, and manufacturing cost standards across the network
* Lead financial visibility and performance management across manufacturing operations and site performance
* Own the Finance contribution to the Supply Review within Integrated Business Planning (IBP), translating capacity, utilization, cost, and inventory decisions into financial outcomes
* Evaluate operational trade\-offs and support decisions that improve both financial and operational outcomes and communicate accordingly with other stakeholders
* Monitor performance against commitments and identify risks, opportunities, and corrective actions
* Partner with Operations to improve performance measurement, processes, tools, and operational insights
* Lead, develop, and set standards for the plant controller team across the manufacturing network
* Shift finance effort from reporting to decision support by leveraging data, tools, and improved ways of working


Qualifications
  
* Bachelor’s degree in finance/accounting; CPA and/or MBA preferred
* Proven finance leadership experience in Manufacturing, Operations Finance, or Plant Controllership environments
* 10\+ years in finance with significant experience in cost accounting and multi\-site manufacturing
* Deep understanding of standard costing, BOM governance, variance analysis, and capital evaluation
* Demonstrated ability to influence operating leaders and operate at the enterprise level
* Experience leading distributed or multi\-site finance teams
* Ability to operate effectively with ambiguity and make meaningful trade\-offs
* Direct, pragmatic, and outcome\-focused leadership style
* Advanced financial, analytical, and systems capabilities


Gay Lea Foods is a Canadian, dairy farmer owned co operative with a clear purpose: to enrich life with dairy. Founded in 1958, the co operative produces high quality dairy products while creating lasting value for farming families, meaningful opportunities for employees, and positive impact in communities across Canada. As a co operative, Gay Lea Foods believes that when the business succeeds, its members, people, and communities should succeed along with it. To learn more, visit gaylea.com.
  
Gay Lea Foods is an equal\-opportunity employer and values diversity in our workplace.
  
Reasonable accommodation is available upon request throughout our recruitment and selection process.
  
Gay Lea Foods may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support aspects of the recruitment process, including screening and assessment.
  
We are currently accepting applications for this open position.
  
Thank you for your interest in Gay Lea Foods.
  
Wishing you all the best with your career search!

**What is the Opportunity?**

This is an opportunity to lead the Data, AI, KYC and Specialized Business portfolio within RBC Caribbean Banking Technology, a team dedicated to delivering modern, resilient solutions for our Caribbean businesses and clients. We are all in on Agile delivery, DevOps, open source, cloud and modern engineering practices, and the work is highly visible: our applications are used daily by RBC staff and clients across the region.


Reporting to the Senior Director, the Director owns three connected mandates. First, the modernization of the Caribbean data foundation: evolving the data lake, data architecture and data products so that the business can trust and use its data. Second, AI engineering: building and operating production grade AI solutions for clients and colleagues, from generative and agentic AI to intelligent automation, with responsible AI and regulatory controls built in. Third, software development and delivery for KYC and Specialized Business Applications: leading the engineering team accountable for a portfolio of vendor applications and for active development of the KYC platform, and delivering the associated project portfolio on time and with quality.


The successful candidate combines hands on technical credibility in data and AI engineering with proven project delivery, vendor management and people leadership, and a clear understanding of the banking industry’s data, processes and regulatory obligations. They are comfortable navigating ambiguity and leading in a fast paced, rapidly evolving technology environment.

* Establish the engineering foundations for AI at scale: reusable patterns for LLM integration, retrieval augmented generation (RAG), agent orchestration, evaluation and testing frameworks, prompt and context management, and an AI asset registry with versioning.
* Lead operational support for AI solutions in production: monitoring and observability, incident management, logging, performance tuning, drift and quality detection, and AIOps.
* Champion ethical and responsible AI: ensure all initiatives comply with RBC policies and regulatory requirements applicable to banking in Canada and the Caribbean (e.g., OSFI guidance, model risk management, privacy legislation), and partner with Risk, Compliance and Legal on approvals.

* Lead the software development team accountable for a portfolio of vendor applications supporting Specialized Business functions, including release management, configuration, integration, upgrades, incident response and production support.
* Lead active development of the KYC platform: own the backlog, architecture direction, engineering quality, security and delivery cadence, in close partnership with AML/Compliance and Operations stakeholders.

**Job Description**

**What is the opportunity?**


At RBC Insurance, AI is fundamental to transforming how we operate, serve our customers, and compete in a rapidly evolving financial services landscape. To realize this opportunity, we need a visionary leader who can simultaneously architect and enable enterprise AI capabilities, modernize and enhance our data platforms, and transform our legacy integration infrastructure into a nimble, scalable foundation.


As Senior Director, AI and Data \& Integration Platforms, you will own the strategy and end\-to\-end delivery across all three domains. You'll be responsible for building the intelligent, data\-driven foundation that enables RBC Insurance to unlock AI\-driven intelligence to enhance customer experiences, and fundamentally transform our business model. This is your opportunity to lead one of the most consequential technology transformations in our organization's history.

 **What will you do?**

  

* Own enterprise AI strategy and delivery: Develop and execute the long\-term vision for AI capabilities across RBC Insurance IT and business operations. Identify frontier, game\-changing AI use cases that drive competitive advantage, serve as the expert for emerging AI technologies, and position RBC Insurance as an AI\-first organization.
* Architect and modernize data platforms: Lead the strategic transformation of our global data foundation, stabilizing and enhancing both on\-premises and cloud data platforms. Build a scalable, secure, resilient data architecture that serves as the foundation for AI, analytics, and business intelligence. Ensure data governance, quality, and accessibility across the enterprise while optimizing cost and performance.
* Transform legacy integration platforms: Champion the modernization of our integration infrastructure, moving from legacy systems to API\-first, event\-driven architectures. Design integration platforms that enable seamless data flow, real\-time decision\-making, and agile business capability delivery.
* Drive strategy into delivery at scale: Translate strategic vision into executable roadmaps and quarterly milestones. Lead end\-to\-end execution of transformational initiatives spanning AI implementation, data platform migration, and integration modernization. Establish accountability for delivery excellence, quality, and measurable business outcomes.
* Build and lead high\-performing teams: Provide strategic leadership to data architects, AI engineers, integration specialists, and technical teams. Foster a high\-performance culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. Coach technical leaders on strategic thinking, delivery excellence, and career development. Build a team of thought leaders who stay at the forefront of AI, data, and integration technologies.
* Build strategic partnerships and stakeholder alignment: Serve as the trusted delivery partner to business leaders, IT executives, and technology teams. Cultivate strong relationships across Technology, Digital Channels, Business Operations, and Product teams. Align organizational priorities, remove obstacles, and drive speed to impact through collaborative leadership..
* Champion continuous learning: Cultivate a team of technical thought leaders who stay at the forefront of industry trends, emerging technologies, and digital platform best practices, ensuring RBC Insurance maintains competitive advantage and drives innovation across digital channels.

 **What do you need to succeed?**

**Must Have**

* 10\+ years of progressive leadership in AI, data, and/or technology transformation, with 5\+ years leading technical teams delivering enterprise\-scale IT solutions. Demonstrated track record of executing transformational business strategy and delivering measurable organizational impact.
* Deep expertise in artificial intelligence and machine learning: Proven experience architecting, implementing, and scaling AI solutions in production environments. Strong understanding of GenAI and Agentic AI applications across business operations, including predictive analytics, automation, and intelligent decision\-making. Ability to translate AI capabilities into business value and organizational efficiencies.
* Expert\-level data platform leadership: Extensive experience designing, building, and modernizing enterprise data platforms (data lakes, data warehouses, cloud platforms). Proficiency with both legacy and modern data technologies. Strong foundation in data governance, quality, integration, and analytics.
* Integration platform and modernization expertise: Experience leading the transformation of legacy integration infrastructure to modern architectures. Deep understanding of API\-first design, event\-driven systems, and hybrid technology ecosystems
* Enterprise delivery and execution excellence: Demonstrated ability to lead complex, multi\-year transformational programs at enterprise scale within financial institutions or regulated industries. Strong foundation in software development lifecycle, budgeting, resource allocation, and delivery governance.
* Executive leadership and stakeholder influence: Exceptional ability to lead diverse technical teams and influence senior stakeholders through data\-driven decision\-making, compelling communication, and strategic facilitation. Strong executive presence and ability to operate at the C\-level.

 **Nice to Have**

* Prior experience in financial services or regulated industries, with deep understanding of compliance, risk management, and enterprise governance frameworks.
* Hands\-on experience with specific AI/ML platforms (e.g., cloud AI services, Agentic AI, LLMs, GenAI, MCP, etc), modern data platforms (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake), and integration technologies (e.g. Apache Kafka, APIGee, event streaming, etc).

**About the Role**

As Director, Technology Delivery Lead, you are accountable for the end\-to\-end technology delivery of Em, BMO InvestorLine's premier AI agent. You will lead the integrated delivery system across AI engineering, wealth platforms, Microsoft Azure, data, architecture, quality engineering, cybersecurity, operations, and third parties to deliver safe, resilient, scalable, and measurable client outcomes.


You will operate as the principal technology counterpart to the Product Owner for Em. Together, you are jointly accountable for overall delivery: the Product Owner leads product vision, client value, priorities, and acceptance; the Technology Delivery Lead owns the integrated technology plan, engineering execution, technical quality, production readiness, and predictable delivery. This role is not a program coordination position. It is a hands\-on senior technology leadership role with clear decision rights and accountability for outcomes.  



**Mandate and Decision Rights**

* Own the integrated technology delivery plan for Em from discovery and architecture through build, evaluation, release, operation, and continuous improvement.
* Jointly commit scope, sequencing, release outcomes, and delivery forecasts with the Product Owner, balancing client value, technical feasibility, risk, cost, and capacity.
* Make or escalate timely technology delivery decisions across architecture, engineering, environments, data, integration, testing, controls, and production readiness.
* Hold delivery teams and partners accountable for agreed outcomes, quality standards, dependencies, and evidence\-based release criteria.
Protect the product from unmanaged technical debt, fragmented ownership, late\-stage controls, and delivery practices that are not fit for AI.  
* 

**Key Responsibilities**

1\. **End\-to\-End Technology Delivery**

* Lead delivery across multiple cross\-functional product and platform teams, establishing one integrated plan, clear critical path, transparent dependencies, and accountable owners.
* Convert the product roadmap into executable technology increments, release plans, capacity models, milestones, and outcome\-based commitments.
* Drive delivery discipline across scope, schedule, cost, quality, resources, risk, and benefits, using forecasts rather than artificial certainty.
* Identify constraints early, remove impediments, resolve cross\-team trade\-offs, and escalate decisions with clear options and recommendations.
Ensure each release has explicit entry, exit, acceptance, operational readiness, and rollback criteria.  
* 

**2\. AI Engineering and AI SDLC Leadership**

* Apply deep knowledge of generative AI and agentic systems, including LLM orchestration, tool use, retrieval\-augmented generation, prompt and context engineering, evaluations, guardrails, memory, and human oversight.
* Embed full\-lifecycle AI SDLC practices across requirements, design, build, test, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and model or prompt change management.
* Ensure AI quality is measured using fit\-for\-purpose evaluations covering safety, groundedness, relevance, accuracy, latency, reliability, and client experience.
* Champion specification\-driven development, automation, reusable engineering patterns, and AI\-assisted software delivery where approved.
Ensure deterministic software testing and probabilistic AI evaluation are integrated into CI/CD and release decisions.  
* 

**3\. Azure, Architecture and Platform Integration**

* Provide senior technical leadership for solutions deployed on Microsoft Azure and integrated with BMO InvestorLine and Wealth Management platforms.
* Partner with solution, enterprise, security, data, and platform architects to maintain an approved, scalable target architecture and prevent local optimization or avoidable technical debt.
* Ensure APIs, event flows, data services, identity, access, observability, resilience, and non\-functional requirements are designed and delivered end to end.
* Drive environment readiness, infrastructure as code, automated deployment, telemetry, performance engineering, capacity planning, disaster recovery, and production support readiness.
Promote reuse of enterprise AI capabilities, shared services, patterns, and controls while preserving clear service boundaries and ownership.  
* 

**4\. Advanced Agile and Value\-Stream Delivery**

* Establish and continuously improve an advanced Agile operating model organized around persistent, cross\-functional teams and measurable client or business outcomes.
* Lead portfolio and product\-level planning, backlog readiness, dependency management, release forecasting, and flow optimization across multiple teams.
* Use evidence\-based metrics such as lead time, cycle time, throughput, work in progress, predictability, escaped defects, reliability, evaluation performance, and value realization.
* Reduce handoffs, unnecessary governance, meeting load, and blocked work; create fast decision paths and clear single\-point accountability.
Coach delivery leaders, Scrum Masters, engineering leads, and teams in modern product delivery, DevSecOps, continuous delivery, and learning\-driven retrospectives.  
* 

**5\. Quality, Risk and Responsible AI**

* Build quality, privacy, security, regulatory compliance, model risk, accessibility, and responsible AI requirements into delivery from inception, not as release\-end checkpoints.
* Partner with Legal, Risk, Compliance, Cybersecurity, Privacy, Model Risk, Data Governance, and Technology Risk to establish proportionate controls and auditable evidence.

jobs.title: Director, Brand & Content Strategy
jobs.description:
**Compensation Range:**

$180\-$195K


**Compensation Disclaimer:**  

The salary range listed reflects the base pay for this role at Altus Group and is provided where required by local regulations. Actual offers may differ based on experience, market conditions, and other relevant factors. The range does not include additional compensation such as bonuses, equity, benefits, or other incentives.


**Who We Need**

Reporting to the Vice President, Marketing Communications, we are hiring a Director, Brand \& Content Strategy to lead the development and execution of Altus Group’s global brand narrative and content strategy. As our new Director, Brand \& Content Strategy, you will shape how we tell the Altus story across markets, audiences, and channels, connecting our corporate brand with our product strategy, proprietary data, industry expertise, and market insights. You will set the strategic direction for brand positioning and content while remaining close to execution, guiding editorial decisions, strengthening the processes and measures behind our content ecosystem, and partnering across Product Marketing, Digital Marketing, PR, Research, Sales, and subject matter experts to deliver relevant, differentiated storytelling globally.


*This is a remote\-first role with a preference for candidates based in the Greater Toronto Area. You will work remotely with in\-person collaboration at our Toronto office as needed.*

**What’s in it for you**

*Ownership and influence.* You will have the opportunity to shape how Altus Group tells its story globally at a pivotal point in the evolution of its brand and marketing strategy. With significant ownership over brand narrative and content strategy, you will have the freedom to bring forward new ideas, establish stronger processes and measures, and influence how the function evolves. You will also help shape and develop a lean team, creating the structure and capabilities needed to deliver against the strategy.


*Visibility and partnership.* This is a highly collaborative role with exposure across the organization. You will work closely with Product Marketing, Digital Marketing, PR, Research, Sales, subject matter experts, and executive leaders, connecting product strategy, proprietary data, market insights, and corporate priorities into a cohesive global story. You will have the opportunity to influence how Altus Group shows up across markets while adapting that story for different audiences, regions, and channels.


*Creative and strategic impact.* Altus Group has been through significant transformation, creating an opportunity to rethink how brand and content contribute to the business. You will have room to challenge existing approaches, define more meaningful measures of success, and explore how shifts in search, AI, social media, and content consumption should influence the strategy. While this is a Director\-level role setting the longer\-term direction, you will remain close enough to the work to see your ideas move from strategy through execution and measure their impact.


**As our new Director of Brand and Content Strategy, you will:**

* **Shape the global brand narrative.** You will define and evolve Altus Group’s brand positioning, category narrative, value proposition, tone of voice, and messaging architecture. You will bring together corporate priorities, product strategy, proprietary data, market insights, and industry expertise to create a clear and differentiated story that can be applied consistently across global markets.
* **Lead the content strategy.** You will develop and execute an integrated global content strategy and editorial plan aligned with business priorities, campaigns, customer personas, and regional needs. You will determine where and how Altus Group’s stories should come to life across digital, social, email, multimedia, events, and emerging channels to build awareness, engagement, demand, and loyalty.
* **Turn expertise and insights into compelling stories.** You will partner with Product Marketing, Research, PR, Sales, and subject matter experts to uncover the ideas and insights that differentiate Altus Group. You will connect product and corporate storytelling, translating complex information into relevant narratives for different audiences and markets.
* **Set the standard for content** . You will provide strategic and editorial direction across content created by your team, internal contributors, and external partners. You will review and edit work with a strong eye for clarity, quality, brand consistency, and reputational risk, ensuring content reflects Altus Group’s voice and supports the broader business strategy.
* **Build a scalable content engine** . You will establish the workflows, governance, tools, and processes needed to move content effectively from idea through development, approval, production, and distribution. You will manage the content marketing budget, balance priorities and resources, and identify opportunities to improve how the team operates as the function evolves.
* **Measure and evolve the strategy.** You will define meaningful brand and content KPIs and use performance data to understand what is resonating and where the strategy needs to change. You will bring a forward\-looking perspective to evolving areas such as AI, AEO, search, social platforms, and changing content behaviours, using insights to continually strengthen performance.
* **Lead and influence** . You will lead and develop the Brand and Content team while building strong partnerships across a matrixed global organization. You will bring recommendations and strategic narratives to senior and executive leaders, create alignment across stakeholders, and help teams translate the global strategy into relevant execution across regions.

**You bring:**

* **The brand and content leadership** . You have led brand and content strategy in a complex organization, ideally within a B2B, SaaS, technology, data\-driven, or similarly

----------------

Purpose
  
Gay Lea is modernizing its finance function to better support enterprise decision\-making, performance, and growth. This includes reducing manual reporting, strengthening planning processes, and leveraging improved tools and data capabilities.
  
This role is accountable for the financial performance of the manufacturing network, partnering with Operations to improve profitability through better manufacturing performance, asset utilization, and cost management.
  
The role owns costing methodology and manufacturing cost standards across the network and leads the plant controller community in delivering consistent financial visibility and performance management across all sites.
  
As a senior business partner to Operations leadership, the role converts plant and network data into operational decisions, surfaces cost and capacity trade\-offs, and shifts site finance effort from reporting to decision support.
  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**  

* Partner with Operations to improve profitability through manufacturing performance, asset utilization, and cost management
* Support manufacturing decisions through financial analysis of costs, productivity, capacity, and investments
* Develop consistent costing methodologies, BOM governance, and manufacturing cost standards across the network
* Lead financial visibility and performance management across manufacturing operations and site performance
* Own the Finance contribution to the Supply Review within Integrated Business Planning (IBP), translating capacity, utilization, cost, and inventory decisions into financial outcomes
* Evaluate operational trade\-offs and support decisions that improve both financial and operational outcomes and communicate accordingly with other stakeholders
* Monitor performance against commitments and identify risks, opportunities, and corrective actions
* Partner with Operations to improve performance measurement, processes, tools, and operational insights
* Lead, develop, and set standards for the plant controller team across the manufacturing network
* Shift finance effort from reporting to decision support by leveraging data, tools, and improved ways of working


Qualifications
  
* Bachelor’s degree in finance/accounting; CPA and/or MBA preferred
* Proven finance leadership experience in Manufacturing, Operations Finance, or Plant Controllership environments
* 10\+ years in finance with significant experience in cost accounting and multi\-site manufacturing
* Deep understanding of standard costing, BOM governance, variance analysis, and capital evaluation
* Demonstrated ability to influence operating leaders and operate at the enterprise level
* Experience leading distributed or multi\-site finance teams
* Ability to operate effectively with ambiguity and make meaningful trade\-offs
* Direct, pragmatic, and outcome\-focused leadership style
* Advanced financial, analytical, and systems capabilities


Gay Lea Foods is a Canadian, dairy farmer owned co operative with a clear purpose: to enrich life with dairy. Founded in 1958, the co operative produces high quality dairy products while creating lasting value for farming families, meaningful opportunities for employees, and positive impact in communities across Canada. As a co operative, Gay Lea Foods believes that when the business succeeds, its members, people, and communities should succeed along with it. To learn more, visit gaylea.com.

new_jobs.title: Director, Brand & Content Strategy
new_jobs.description:
**Compensation Range:**

$180\-$195K


**Compensation Disclaimer:**  

The salary range listed reflects the base pay for this role at Altus Group and is provided where required by local regulations. Actual offers may differ based on experience, market conditions, and other relevant factors. The range does not include additional compensation such as bonuses, equity, benefits, or other incentives.


**Who We Need**

Reporting to the Vice President, Marketing Communications, we are hiring a Director, Brand \& Content Strategy to lead the development and execution of Altus Group’s global brand narrative and content strategy. As our new Director, Brand \& Content Strategy, you will shape how we tell the Altus story across markets, audiences, and channels, connecting our corporate brand with our product strategy, proprietary data, industry expertise, and market insights. You will set the strategic direction for brand positioning and content while remaining close to execution, guiding editorial decisions, strengthening the processes and measures behind our content ecosystem, and partnering across Product Marketing, Digital Marketing, PR, Research, Sales, and subject matter experts to deliver relevant, differentiated storytelling globally.


*This is a remote\-first role with a preference for candidates based in the Greater Toronto Area. You will work remotely with in\-person collaboration at our Toronto office as needed.*

**What’s in it for you**

*Ownership and influence.* You will have the opportunity to shape how Altus Group tells its story globally at a pivotal point in the evolution of its brand and marketing strategy. With significant ownership over brand narrative and content strategy, you will have the freedom to bring forward new ideas, establish stronger processes and measures, and influence how the function evolves. You will also help shape and develop a lean team, creating the structure and capabilities needed to deliver against the strategy.


*Visibility and partnership.* This is a highly collaborative role with exposure across the organization. You will work closely with Product Marketing, Digital Marketing, PR, Research, Sales, subject matter experts, and executive leaders, connecting product strategy, proprietary data, market insights, and corporate priorities into a cohesive global story. You will have the opportunity to influence how Altus Group shows up across markets while adapting that story for different audiences, regions, and channels.


*Creative and strategic impact.* Altus Group has been through significant transformation, creating an opportunity to rethink how brand and content contribute to the business. You will have room to challenge existing approaches, define more meaningful measures of success, and explore how shifts in search, AI, social media, and content consumption should influence the strategy. While this is a Director\-level role setting the longer\-term direction, you will remain close enough to the work to see your ideas move from strategy through execution and measure their impact.


**As our new Director of Brand and Content Strategy, you will:**

* **Shape the global brand narrative.** You will define and evolve Altus Group’s brand positioning, category narrative, value proposition, tone of voice, and messaging architecture. You will bring together corporate priorities, product strategy, proprietary data, market insights, and industry expertise to create a clear and differentiated story that can be applied consistently across global markets.
* **Lead the content strategy.** You will develop and execute an integrated global content strategy and editorial plan aligned with business priorities, campaigns, customer personas, and regional needs. You will determine where and how Altus Group’s stories should come to life across digital, social, email, multimedia, events, and emerging channels to build awareness, engagement, demand, and loyalty.
* **Turn expertise and insights into compelling stories.** You will partner with Product Marketing, Research, PR, Sales, and subject matter experts to uncover the ideas and insights that differentiate Altus Group. You will connect product and corporate storytelling, translating complex information into relevant narratives for different audiences and markets.
* **Set the standard for content** . You will provide strategic and editorial direction across content created by your team, internal contributors, and external partners. You will review and edit work with a strong eye for clarity, quality, brand consistency, and reputational risk, ensuring content reflects Altus Group’s voice and supports the broader business strategy.
* **Build a scalable content engine** . You will establish the workflows, governance, tools, and processes needed to move content effectively from idea through development, approval, production, and distribution. You will manage the content marketing budget, balance priorities and resources, and identify opportunities to improve how the team operates as the function evolves.
* **Measure and evolve the strategy.** You will define meaningful brand and content KPIs and use performance data to understand what is resonating and where the strategy needs to change. You will bring a forward\-looking perspective to evolving areas such as AI, AEO, search, social platforms, and changing content behaviours, using insights to continually strengthen performance.
* **Lead and influence** . You will lead and develop the Brand and Content team while building strong partnerships across a matrixed global organization. You will bring recommendations and strategic narratives to senior and executive leaders, create alignment across stakeholders, and help teams translate the global strategy into relevant execution across regions.

**You bring:**

* **The brand and content leadership** . You have led brand and content strategy in a complex organization, ideally within a B2B, SaaS, technology, data\-driven, or similarly
